title: Figure 33. Percentage of Impacts Between Flight Line and Any Radial (Atlas IIAS)
description: Line graph plotting cumulative Percent of impacts against Theta (deg), 0–180, labeled "Data for Atlas IIAS" with B = 1000. Five curves show A = 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0 and 5.0; higher A concentrates impacts nearer the flight line. Text notes about 46% of Mode-5 impacts lie between 0° and 20° for A = 3.0, rising to about 64% for A = 4.0. Captioned "Figure 33. Percentage of Impacts Between Flight Line and Any Radial".
